title: Verify mastery: Federated Cross-Node Consensus
goal: VC-200-001 (P1) claims mastery of: P2P Non-blocking Swarm. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: UDP LAN discovery, TCP JSON-RPC peer dispatch, and trust-score ranking already worked. Closed the routing gap the code itself flagged ("bloom-filters of peer registries for perfect routing"): peers now exchange a real 256-bit `CapabilityBloom` of their registered tool names during ping/pong, and `rank_peers_for_goal` scores peers by goal/capability overlap instead of trust alone (`src/gaw. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_200_001_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
